other_conditions: Nominee must be an active resident Indian scientist or academician with an outstanding research track record in STEM or medicine, particularly during the last five years
Must have received recognition from national or international scientific bodies such as fellowships in prestigious academies or S&T awards
Must not hold any administrative roles or receive any honorarium, fellowship, or salary from any other institute or organization at the time of award initiation
Must be affiliated with an academic institution or R&D lab, or have consent from the future host institution
The nominee should be a senior superannuated scientist willing to continue research activities
benefits_summary: The award provides a fellowship of ₹1.5 Lakhs per month together with a research grant of ₹25 Lakhs per annum (₹1 Lakh overhead to the host institution).
